selection: Selected before downloading or inspecting responses: a non-coding cultural-knowledge benchmark in the official inventory, with public binary item-level metadata and a small tabular release.
schema_amendment: Before reading outcomes: 51,760 prompt variants map to 9,512 language-qualified raw IDs and 4,756 parallel source questions. Replace full-prompt lexical grouping with source-question grouping across languages and few-shot variants, merging additional lexical matches on final user questions. Primary item split and predictors are unchanged.
comparison: Fixed Beta(1,1) versus empirical mean; constant 0.5 is a reference. No fitting, tuning, or new predictor.
eligibility: All groups with at least 80 distinct observed items. Report missing grades, repeated outcomes and infeasible guarded splits; do not replace the benchmark based on scores.
endpoint: Mean paired Brier ALC difference, Beta(1,1) minus empirical mean, equally weighted over subject-benchmark pairs and the three acquisition seeds. Negative indicates improvement on this benchmark.
diagnostics: All budgets, all seed deltas, pair wins/losses, low-success failure cases, and lexical split sensitivity. No significance test or benchmark-level confidence interval from a single benchmark.
interpretation: One prospective local validation after two exploratory coding benchmarks. This is not a private competition test or a reusable untouched holdout after inspection. Any later changes need new validation.
